name: drawer-directions
title: Drawer directions
description: Drawers from the end side and the top.

files.content:
import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { Button } from '@/ui/button/button'; import { DrawerContent, DrawerDescription, DrawerFooter, DrawerHeader, DrawerOverlay, DrawerTitle, Drawer, DrawerClose, DrawerPortal, DrawerTrigger, } from '@/ui/drawer/drawer'; /** * Drawers from the end side and the top, each dragged back toward its * own edge. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-drawer-directions', imports: [ Button, DrawerContent, DrawerDescription, DrawerFooter, DrawerHeader, DrawerOverlay, DrawerTitle, Drawer, DrawerClose, DrawerPortal, DrawerTrigger, ], template: `
@for (direction of directions; track direction) {

{{ direction }} drawer

Drag it toward its edge to close it.

 }
`, }) export class DrawerDirectionsExample { protected readonly directions = ['end', 'top'] as const; }
